topic: Using a Coupon at the Grocery Checkout

script.title: THE EXPIRED COUPON
script.scene_zh: 超市收銀台 · 使用折價券
script.story_hook: One expired coupon, one empty shelf, one kind manager.
script.intro_zh: 一張過期的折價券、一個空貨架，和一位很友善的經理。
script.welcome_en: Welcome! Today's checkout has a coupon surprise. Listen how a small paper ticket saves the day.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎！今天的結帳時刻有一張折價券的小意外。聽聽一張小紙券怎麼扭轉局面。
script.outro: That's coupon day at the grocery store. Shadow the polite asking lines next time you shop.
script.outro_zh: 這正是超市裡的折價券日常。下次結帳前，先跟著唸那些有禮貌的問句。
script.practice_intro_en: Now you talk! Repeat each line with a friendly voice.
script.practice_intro_zh: 換你開口了！用友善的語調跟讀每一句。
script.char_a_description: a grandmotherly woman in her early sixties with silver hair in a soft bun, round reading glasses, wearing a floral cardigan over a pale blue blouse, beige slacks, small build, warm smile, holding a paper coupon.
script.char_b_description: a teenage boy around seventeen with short sandy hair and a light dusting of freckles, wearing a green store vest over a black hoodie, lanky build, name tag reading Leo, quick polite grin.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi! Can I use this paper coupon?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ kən aɪ juːz ðɪs ˈpeɪɚ ˈkupɑn/
dialogue.zh: 嗨！我可以用這張紙本折價券嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure! What's the coupon for?
dialogue.zh: 當然可以！這張券是用來買什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says two yogurts, vanilla.
dialogue.zh: 上面寫要買兩盒香草酸奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, are they here in your basket?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɑr ðeɪ hɪr ɪn jʊr ˈbæskɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，它們在你的籃子裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh... these are strawberry. Sorry!
dialogue.zh: 噢……這些是草莓味的。抱歉！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, the scanner wants vanilla exactly.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，掃描機要的是香草口味，要一模一樣才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is vanilla still in your store?
dialogue.zh: 你們店裡還有香草味的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me look it up... the shelf is empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi lʊk ɪt ʌp ðə ʃɛlf ɪz ˈɛmpi/
dialogue.zh: 我查一下……貨架空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, that's my bad luck, then.
dialogue.zh: 唉，那我今天真是不順。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe we restock after lunch.
dialogue.zh: 也許我們午後會補貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can't wait that long, dear.
dialogue.zh: 我沒辦法等那麼久，孩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The date! Oh, it expired last Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə deɪt oʊ ɪt ɪkˈspaɪərd læst ˈsʌndeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 看日期！噢，它上星期日就到期了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you mean?
dialogue.zh: 你這是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See the small print? Right here.
dialogue.zh: 看到下面的小字了嗎？就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Expired? But I got it yesterday!
dialogue.zh: 過期了？可我昨天才拿到！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where did you get it?
dialogue.zh: 你在哪裡拿到它的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It came with the cereal box, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt keɪm wɪð ðə ˈsɪriəl ˈbɑks jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 它是跟麥片盒一起附贈的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's old stock then. Sorry, ma'am.
dialogue.zh: 那是舊的批次了。很抱歉，小姐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So should I just throw it away?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ʃʊd aɪ dʒʌst θroʊ ɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 所以我只能把它丟掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold on, let me ask my manager.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn lɛt mi ɑsk maɪ ˈmænɪdʒɚ/
dialogue.zh: 等一下，讓我問問我們經理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's too much trouble.
dialogue.zh: 噢，那太麻煩你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not at all! She handles coupons daily.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ət ɔl ʃi ˈhændəlz ˈkupɑnz ˈdeɪli/
dialogue.zh: 一點都不麻煩！她天天處理折價券。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a sweet boy, then.
dialogue.zh: 你真是個貼心的孩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Be right back. Watch lane four?
dialogue.zh: 我馬上回來。可以幫我看著四號通道嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Of course, go right ahead, sweetie.
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，快去快回，親愛的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, she says one time is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ʃi sɛz wʌn taɪm ɪz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 好，經理說通融這一次沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One time? What does that mean?
dialogue.zh: 這一次？那是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Honor it once, just this time.
dialogue.zh: 她說照券價算，就這一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh my! That's really kind.
dialogue.zh: 天啊！她人真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But you still need the vanilla.
dialogue.zh: 但你還是需要香草酸奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the shelf is empty...
dialogue.zh: 可是貨架是空的……

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's one case out back, I think!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz wʌn keɪs aʊt bæk aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我想後倉還有一整箱！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would that be asking too much?
dialogue.zh: 這樣要求會不會太過分？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll check! Watch the register a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tʃɛk wɑtʃ ðə ˈrɛdʒɪstɚ ə ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 我去看看！幫我顧一下收銀台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your time, honey.
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，孩子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it! Six vanillas, right here.
dialogue.zh: 找到了！六盒香草的，就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're an angel, young man!
dialogue.zh: 你真是天使啊，小兄弟！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, I'm just fast. Two yogurts?
dialogue.zh: 哈，我只是動作快。兩盒酸奶？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two, please. What's the total now?
dialogue.zh: 兩盒，謝謝。現在總共多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coupons first... one dollar off each.
dialogue.zh: 先折價券……每盒折一元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And do you have a loyalty card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ən du ju həv ə ˈlɔələti kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 你們有會員卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes! It's free. Want one?
dialogue.zh: 有！免費申辦。你要辦一張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, is there a form to fill?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ɪz ðɛr ə fɔrm tə fɪl/
dialogue.zh: 呃，需要填寫表格嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just your phone number, that's all.
dialogue.zh: 只需留手機號碼，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, easy! Here, 555-3321.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ˈizi hɪr ˈfɪv faɪv ˈfɪv θri ˈtu wʌn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done... you saved two more dollars.
dialogue.zh: 搞定……你又省了兩元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now that's a good checkout day.
dialogue.zh: 這才是漂亮的一天呀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bag the eggs up top?
dialogue.zh: 雞蛋放最上面裝袋好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please! Careful, they crack fast.
dialogue.zh: 好的，拜託！小心，它們很容易破。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eggs always go on top. Don't worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛɡz ˈɔlweɪz ɡoʊ ɑn tɑp doʊnt ˈwɝi/
dialogue.zh: 雞蛋一定放最上層。別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My grandson loves these yogurts.
dialogue.zh: 我孫子最喜歡這些酸奶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, birthday shopping? That's the best kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ˈbɝθˌdeɪ ˈʃɑpɪŋ ðæts ðə bɛst kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 啊，生日採購？那是最棒的購物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His birthday is Saturday, you see.
dialogue.zh: 他這週六過生日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice! Did you get candles yet?
dialogue.zh: 真棒！蠟燭買了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Candles? Oh no, I forgot completely!
dialogue.zh: 蠟燭？噢不，我完全忘了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aisle nine, left side, top shelf.
dialogue.zh: 九號走道，左邊那一側，最上面那層貨架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You know this store like home.
dialogue.zh: 你對這間超市熟得像自己的家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I grew up two blocks away, ma'am.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡru ʌp tu blɑks əˈweɪ mæm/
dialogue.zh: 我就在兩個街口外長大的，小姐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you for saving my whole day.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju fɚ ˈseɪvɪŋ maɪ hoʊl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你救了我一整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Have a great party! Come back soon!
dialogue.phonetic: /hæv ə ɡreɪt ˈpɑrti kʌm bæk sun/
dialogue.zh: 祝你派對成功！要再來光顧喔！

60句超市結帳真實對話，聽完就能自己用折價券、請店員通融、順手辦會員卡！

這一集走進超市收銀台。一位阿嬤拿著一張過期的香草酸奶折價券，貨架又剛好賣光。看她怎麼跟年輕收銀員一起想辦法：問經理通融一次、到後倉找回庫存、還多辦了免費會員卡。

你會練到：
- 詢問能用什麼券：「What's the coupon for?」
- 有禮地請求幫忙：「Would that be asking too much?」
- 申辦會員卡：「Just your phone number, that's all.」
- 真誠道謝：「Thank you for saving my whole day.」

script.youtube_description_en:
60 lines of real grocery checkout English you can hear and use today.

In this episode, a grandma brings an expired yogurt coupon to the checkout, and the vanilla shelf is empty. Listen as the teen cashier asks the manager for a one-time override, finds a case out back, and even signs her up for a free loyalty card.

You will practice:
- Starting the ask: Hi! Can I use this paper coupon?
- Polite requests: Would that be asking too much?
- Joining the club: Just your phone number, that's all.
- Warm thanks: Thank you for saving my whole day.

The second half is line-by-line listening and shadowing practice. Listen twice, then repeat every line out loud.

Great for A2 learners: no memorizing needed, just listen and you will start using it.

If you enjoy this lesson, subscribe, like, and turn on notifications for a daily English dialogue!

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish

這一集帶大家走進超市收銀台，看一位阿嬤和年輕收銀員如何把一張過期折價券，變成一趟開心的購物之旅。
